messages:
clare-fin: Customer Nimbus submitted a billing dispute for 2026-05-03 claiming ~1.3M embeds billed during a throttled window. They say these should be non-billable because client experienced SDK throttles. Can eng/data triage?

mike-eng: pls share org_id + sample request_ids. Curious if these are duplicates or billed despite 429.

ben-cs: org_id=nimbus-main. Uploaded CSV to secure share and emailed @mike-eng. Customer asked for provisional credit while we investigate.

tara-data: quick headcount on embed_events (region=eu) for 2026-05-03T11:15-11:45 UTC: raw_rows=2,430,911 distinct(request_id, ack_id)=1,132,121 -> delta ~= 1,298,790. Many rows include header metadata rl_status=429 or client_retry=true.

mike-eng: checked rate-limiter logs and rl-proxy traces. There was a misconfigured soft-limit for tenant class "burst-alpha" that returned 200 with header X-RateLimit-Status:429 for short period 11:16:00-11:20:30, causing SDKs to retry. snippet: 

mike-eng: ```
[2026-05-03T11:16:12Z] rl-proxy-3 resp_status=200 headers={X-RateLimit-Status:429} req_id=nm-44
[2026-05-03T11:16:12Z] sdk-client attempt=2 req_id=nm-44 // client saw error and retried
```

mike-eng: root cause: soft-limit flag accidentally toggled to "passthrough" mode for that tenant class in RL config, so gateway responded 200 but left rate-limit info in headers. Our billing pipeline treats any successful ack as billable.

rl-bot: Rate-limiter config change detected. Change RL-2026-05-03-11:16 applied to tenant-class burst-alpha with passthrough=true by deploy-script.automaton.

clare-fin: customer wants full credit for the 1.3M embeds. Proposal: provisional credit $1,428 (1,298,790 * $0.0011 = $1,428.67) while we run a canonical dedupe + header-correlation to mark non-billable attempts. Approve?

mike-eng: engineering note: we can correlate gateway headers to ingest events and mark events as non-billable if we can prove the gateway indicated 429 and the final ack shows a retry from the client. Caveat: some older edge proxies dropped X-RateLimit headers; we'll need to exclude those ambiguous proxies from auto-mark non-billable. 

tara-data: I'll run a full recount that joins embed_events -> ingress_headers -> proxy_logs to produce a reconciliation table with columns: request_id, ack_id, first_hdr_status, final_ack_ts, billable_flag. ETA ~6h.

billing-bot: Created provisional credit ticket FIN-3021 for $1,430 for nimbus-main period=2026-05-03 reason="rate-limiter passthrough -> billed during throttled window" status=pending-approval.

clare-fin: I approve provisional credit $1,430 to get the customer off the line. Label it provisional and note we will true-up after Tara posts final reconciliation.

ben-cs: messaged customer: "We've issued a provisional credit while we reconcile the event-level logs. We'll follow up with final numbers by Thu EOD." Customer replied :thumbsup:.

mike-eng: follow-up mitigation: will push a small RL config validation that prevents passthrough=true for tenant-classes that opted into strict-throttling. Filing ENG-7310. Also adding an ingest-time header capture step to ensure next audit is easier.

tara-data: started the recount job; joining three tables may need sampling first to sanity-check results. I'll post a short interim summary in ~90m and final CSV when done.

clare-fin: thanks, team. Keep this thread updated. We'll finalize FIN-3021 after Tara's reconciliation table.

billing-bot: FIN-3021 status changed to approved-provisional by clare-fin at 2026-05-03T12:05:00Z.
